newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Argo Pantes sets $250 mln MTN programme.
newsitem.headline: Argo Pantes sets $250 mln MTN programme.

text.p: Societe Generale Asia is arranging a US$250 million global medium term note programme for PT Argo Pantes Finance BV, bankers said Thursday.

The issuer is a wholly-owned subsidiary of PT Argo Pantes. Under the programme, the issuer may from time to time issue senior notes in an amount up to US$250 million, or its equivalent in other currencies.
The programme will facilitate issuance of senior notes in flexible structures on both a syndicated and non-syndicated basis denominated in various major currencies.
Notes may be issued off the programme with maturities ranging from one day to 10 years. The programme is not rated and notes issued under the programme will not be listed.

Societe Generale Asia is the arranger and chief dealer for the MTN program whereas Bankers Trust is the fiscal, issuing and principal paying agent. A dealer panel is being formed and is likely to include seven to eight banks.

Bankers said an inaugural issue for PT Argo Pantes to be launched early next year is under negotiation but no mandate has been awarded. They said the first transaction would probably be denominated in US dollars and have a tenor of three years.
Such a deal would likely pay an all-in return to top-tier managers of more than 170 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, bankers said.
